extraction.Refused/Protested: Fee patent issued prior to 1921 without application
extraction.NOTES: Status per Shawnee Indian Agency cover letter: Report mailed to her not returned. Unbundled from Shawnee Indian Agency master list transmitted by Supt. A.W. Leech, March 20, 1929, in response to Circular 2464. Source bundled record: part10_agency_narrative_page035. Document reference: 5-1142. Allotment number not recorded on source list nor in RA spreadsheet. | TASK 5 SHAWNEE FINAL BACKFILL 2026-06-01 (recreated after filter-repo loss): Not found in federal-register-app patents database. May indicate Circular 2464 investigation began but no forced fee patent was consummated, or patent record exists under a different name not currently indexed. Marked as explicitly unresolved per OPERATIONS convention so it is distinguishable from unprocessed rows. Tribe also unknown — every resolvable row on the Shawnee Indian Agency master list turned out to be Citizen Potawatomie, but absent a confirmed database record this row cannot be assigned a definite tribe. | TASK 5 SHAWNEE VERIFICATION 2026-06-02: 2026-06-02 thorough re-lookup against local allotment_research database (allotment_research.all_patents, forced_fee_patents_rails). Searched all DeGraff variants. Found 12 DeGraffs total in OK Pottawatomie + Cleveland counties (Frances, Fanny, Alice, John, William, George ×2 (incl. allot 1213 1917 fee), I J., Joseph ×2 (incl. allot 1050 1927 fee), Clarence ×2 (incl. allot 1051 1919 forced fee, 1983 FedReg case 016), Frances) — none with first initial 'R.' Historian (Christian) reviewed candidates 2026-06-02 and confirmed no clear 'R. DeGraff' match. Most likely OCR-misread candidates (Clarence with C→R, Frances/Fanny with F→R) cannot be confirmed without source-page review of the Shawnee Indian Agency 1929 master list typescript.
